page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn7i-c56g1.14xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance designed for compute-intensive workloads. It features 56 dedicated physical cores powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor running at 2.9 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The instance is equipped with 346.0 GB of system memory, providing 6.18 GB per core. Graphics and parallel processing acceleration are delivered via a single NVIDIA Ampere A10 GPU with 24 GB of VRAM. This instance does not include local storage, and network performance is anchored by a 16 Gbps baseline bandwidth.

Benchmark data highlights the instance's capabilities in parallel processing and machine learning. In LLM inference tests using a small 135M model, it achieves top-tier performance with 9738.91 tokens per second for prompt processing and 457.19 tokens per second for text generation. For a medium 7B model, it sustains 2464.01 tokens per second for prompt processing and 89.85 tokens per second for text generation. Multi-threaded bzip3 decompression and PassMark CPU encryption tests both rank in the strong tier, scoring 262.06 GB/sec and 47417.11 respectively. PassMark database operations also show strong performance at 22187.83, while memory bandwidth and Redis SET operations perform in the average tier.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the combination of 56 dedicated Intel Xeon cores and a dedicated NVIDIA A10 GPU offers a balanced resource density for workloads requiring both high-throughput CPU execution and GPU acceleration without the premium of multi-GPU configurations. The lack of local storage requires external block storage, which is a key architectural tradeoff to consider. This server is highly suited for medium-scale LLM inference, machine learning model deployment, data parallel processing, and database operations.
